d:
Bandham Tamil Movie Songs HD, Mullaikodi Allikadi Video Song featuring Anand Babu, Kajal Kiran and Sivaji Ganesan on Mango Music Tamil. Music composed by Shankar Ganesh, directed by K. Vijayan and produced by Anandavalli Balaji.
Song: Mullaikodi Allikadi
Singers: SPB, Janaki
Lyrics: Pulamaipithan, Vaali
Bandham Tamil Movie also stars Shalini, Jaishankar and Manorama among others.
